children.heading: Programs
children.text: Not later than September 30, 2008, the Administrator, in consultation with the Secretary, shall establish micronutrient fortification programs.

children.heading: Purpose
children.text: The purpose of a program shall be to—
assist developing countries in correcting micronutrient dietary deficiencies among segments of the populations of the countries; and

assess and apply technologies and systems to improve and ensure the quality, shelf life, bioavailability, and safety of fortified food aid agricultural commodities, and products of those agricultural commodities.

tree.heading: Fortification
tree.text: Under a program, grains and other commodities made available to a developing country selected to participate in a program may be fortified with 1 or more micronutrients (such as vitamin A, iron, iodine, and folic acid) with respect to which a substantial portion of the population in the country is deficient. The commodity may be fortified in the United States or in the developing country.

tree.heading: Termination of authority
tree.text: The authority to carry out programs established under this section shall terminate on September 30, 2023.
